name: ^\$enter:arg5$
reason: handleChannelWebhook's own acked closure, passed to receiveChannelWebhook; entering it carries no answer

name: ^adapter\.parse$
reason: channel adapter parser injected through the receiver; its parsed result is the routed input

name: ^adapter ?\.actions(\(message\) \.sendText)?$
reason: channel adapter reply surface; only the arguments sent to it are relied on

name: ^channel \.sendText$
reason: channel adapter send; its result is not read

name: ^context\.(accountLoader|authResolver|deploymentLoader|ingressStatusLoader|waitUntil)$
reason: routing context injected by the server; loaders are storage reads taken as inputs

name: ^event\.channel( \.sendText|\.reactToMessage|\.sendTyping)$
reason: channel adapter side effects whose results are not read

name: ^handlers\.(handleAsyncRequest|handleChannelRequest|handleDirectRequest|handleSandboxJobCompletionRequest|handleStatusRequest)$
reason: run handlers injected by the server; their response is returned unchanged

name: ^otelContextApi\.active$
reason: OpenTelemetry context value carried through unread

name: ^redactSensitiveText$
reason: redaction helper; the twin only continues from its returned text

name: ^redeliver$
reason: the caller's closure deciding redelivery; its boolean is an input

name: ^(setTimeout|clearTimeout|resolve)$
reason: host timer and promise resolver in the ack race; only the timer handle is passed back

name: ^setObservabilityContext$
reason: sets the ambient log scope; no answer is read

name: ^AbortSignal\.timeout$
reason: host signal constructor, passed through to the fetch unread
